atha kho sāḷho ca migāranattā sāṇo ca sekhuniyanattā yen'āyasmā nandako ten'upasaṅkamiṃsu, upasaṅkamitvā āyasmantaṃ nandakaṃ abhivādetvā ekam'antaṃ nisīdiṃsu.

62119.commentary: (MNa) sāṇadhovikaṃ nāmā'ti ettha manussā sāṇasāṭakakaraṇ'atthaṃ sāṇavāke gahetvā muṭṭhiṃ muṭṭhiṃ bandhitvā udake pakkhipanti. te tatiyadivase suṭṭhu kilinnā honti. atha manussā ambilayāgusur'ādīni ādāya tattha gantvā sāṇamuṭṭhiṃ gahetvā, dakkhiṇato vāmato sammukhā cā'ti tīsu phalakesu sakiṃ dakkhiṇaphalake, sakiṃ vāmaphalake, sakiṃ sammukhaphalake paharantā ambilayāgusur'ādīni bhuñjantā pivantā khādantā dhovanti. mahantā kīḷā hoti.

examples.text: seyyathā'pi nāma kuñjaro saṭṭhihāyano gambhīraṃ pokkharaṇiṃ ogāhetvā sāṇadhovikaṃ nāma kīḷitajātaṃ kīḷati, evam'ev'āhaṃ samaṇaṃ gotamaṃ sāṇadhovikaṃ maññe kīḷitajātaṃ kīḷissāmi.
ayaṃ kho me, samma, sāṇabhāro dūr'ābhato ca susannaddho ca, alaṃ me tvaṃ pajānāhī'ti. atha kho so sahāyako sāṇabhāraṃ chaḍḍetvā sāṇasuttabhāraṃ ādiyi.

62121.meaning1: simile of the Sunn hemp carrier

62122.meaning1: like a man with a load of Sunn hemp

examples.text: yo pana so sahāyako suvaṇṇabhāraṃ ādāya agamāsi, tassa mātāpitaro'pi abhinandiṃsu, puttadārā'pi abhinandiṃsu, mittāmaccā'pi abhinandiṃsu, tatonidānañ'ca sukhaṃ somanassaṃ adhigacchi. evam'eva kho tvaṃ, rājañña, sāṇabhārik'ūpamo maññe paṭibhāsi.

62123.meaning1: clothed in Sunn hemp garments; wearing rough clothes

examples.text: atha kho māro pāpimā kassakavaṇṇaṃ abhinimminitvā mahantaṃ naṅgalaṃ khandhe karitvā dīghapācanayaṭṭhiṃ gahetvā haṭahaṭakeso sāṇasāṭinivattho kaddamamakkhitehi pādehi yena bhagavā ten'upasaṅkami, upasaṅkamitvā bhagavantaṃ etadavoca, api, samaṇa, balībadde addasā'ti?
tattha addasaṃsu pahūtaṃ sāṇasuttaṃ chaḍḍitaṃ, disvā sahāyako sahāyakaṃ āmantesi, yassa kho, samma, atthāya iccheyyāma sāṇaṃ, idaṃ pahūtaṃ sāṇasuttaṃ chaḍḍitaṃ.
ayaṃ kho me, samma, sāṇabhāro dūr'ābhato ca susannaddho ca, alaṃ me tvaṃ pajānāhī'ti. atha kho so sahāyako sāṇabhāraṃ chaḍḍetvā sāṇasuttabhāraṃ ādiyi.
tena hi tvaṃ mahante mahante sāṇipasibbake kārāpetvā hiraññasuvaṇṇassa pūrāpetvā sakaṭehi nibbāhāpetvā majjhe gaṅgāya sote osādehi.
paṭicchannaṃ nāma āsanaṃ kuṭṭena vā kavāṭena vā kilañjena vā sāṇipākārena vā rukkhena vā thambhena vā kotthaḷiyā vā yena kenaci paṭicchannaṃ hoti.
etasmiṃ ṭhāne mahāsampatti hoti, bodhisattaṃ parivāretvā nisinnā dhātiyo rañño sampattiṃ passissāmā'ti antosāṇito bahi nikkhantā.

62130.meaning2: hemp-sack; sack of coarse hempen cloth

examples.text: tena hi tvaṃ mahante mahante sāṇipasibbake kārāpetvā hiraññasuvaṇṇassa pūrāpetvā sakaṭehi nibbāhāpetvā majjhe gaṅgāya sote osādehi.

62131.meaning1: folding screen; screen wall; room divider

sayanigharaṃ nāma yattha katthaci rañño sayanaṃ paññattaṃ hoti, antamaso sāṇipākāraparikkhittam'pi.

examples.text: sayanigharaṃ nāma yattha katthaci rañño sayanaṃ paññattaṃ hoti, antamaso sāṇipākāraparikkhittam'pi.
ayaṃ kho me, samma, sāṇabhāro dūr'ābhato ca susannaddho ca, alaṃ me, tvaṃ pajānāhī'ti. atha kho so sahāyako sāṇasuttabhāraṃ chaḍḍetvā sāṇibhāraṃ ādiyi.
seyyathā'pi, bhikkhave, pokkharaṇī acch'odakā sāta-odakā sīt'odakā setakā supatitthā ramaṇīyā.
sātaṃ asātan'ti yam'āhu loke, tam'ūpanissāya pahoti chando, rūpesu disvā vibhavaṃ bhavañ'ca, vinicchayaṃ kubbati jantu loke.
icchānidānā bhavasātabaddhā, te duppamuñcā na hi aññamokkhā, pacchā pure vā'pi apekkhamānā, ime'va kāme purime'va jappaṃ.
yesañ'ca susamāraddhā, niccaṃ kāyagatā sati, akiccaṃ te na sevanti, kicce sātaccakārino, satānaṃ sampajānānaṃ, atthaṃ gacchanti āsavā.
yo so, bhikkhave, bhikkhu satthari kaṅkhati vicikicchati n'ādhimuccati na sampasīdati tassa cittaṃ na namati ātappāya anuyogāya sātaccāya padhānāya.

62140.commentary: (SNa) na samādhismiṃ sātaccakārī'ti jhānappanāya satatakārī na hoti, kadāci'd'eva karoti. (DHPa) sātaccakārino'ti satatakārino aṭṭhitakārino.

examples.text: yesañ'ca susamāraddhā, niccaṃ kāyagatā sati, akiccaṃ te na sevanti, kicce sātaccakārino, satānaṃ sampajānānaṃ, atthaṃ gacchanti āsavā.

idha pana, bhikkhave, ekacco jhāyī samādhismiṃ samādhikusalo ca hoti, samādhismiṃ sātaccakārī ca. tatra, bhikkhave, yv'āyaṃ jhāyī samādhismiṃ samādhikusalo ca hoti, samādhismiṃ sātaccakārī ca ayaṃ imesaṃ catunnaṃ jhāyīnaṃ aggo ca seṭṭho ca mokkho ca uttamo ca pavaro ca.

62143.meaningLit: discourse on doing what is suitable based on perseverance

62144.grammar: ind, adv, acc sg of sātatā
62144.meaning1: happily; agreeably; comfortably; (comm) continuously or comfortably

√san > sā + ta + tā + aṃ
sātatā + aṃ
62144.commentary: (SNa) sātatan'ti satataṃ sukhaṃ vā ciraṃ tiṭṭhantī'ti vadati.

examples.text: sabbhi'r'eva samāsetha, sabbhi kubbetha santhavaṃ, sataṃ saddhammam'aññāya, sattā tiṭṭhanti sātatan'ti.

62145.commentary: (DHPa) sātatikā'ti abhinikkhamanakālato paṭṭhāya yāva arahattamaggā satataṃ pavattakāyikacetasikavīriyā. (THa) sātatiko'ti samaṇadhamme diṭṭhadhammasukhavihāre sātaccayutto. (THa) sātatikā'ti sātaccakārino bhāvanāya satatapavattavīriyā.

examples.text: taṃ jhāyinaṃ sātatikaṃ, sukhumadiṭṭhivipassakaṃ, upādānakkhay'ārāmaṃ, āhu sappuriso iti.
te jhāyino sātatikā, niccaṃ daḷhaparakkamā, phusanti dhīrā nibbānaṃ, yogakkhemaṃ anuttaraṃ.

seyyathā'pi, bhikkhave, ucchubījaṃ vā sālibījaṃ vā muddikābījaṃ vā allāya pathaviyā nikkhittaṃ yañ'c'eva pathavirasaṃ upādiyati yañ'ca āporasaṃ upādiyati sabbaṃ taṃ madhurattāya sātattāya asecanakattāya saṃvattati. taṃ kissa hetu?

62147.meaning1: measure of pleasure; a certain delight; degree of happiness

examples.text: tathā tathā'ssa tāni vaṇamukhāni asucitarāni c'eva honti duggandhatarāni ca pūtikatarāni ca, hoti c'eva kāci sātamattā assādamattā, yadidaṃ vaṇamukhānaṃ kaṇḍūvanahetu.

62148.commentary: (DNa) yaṃ loke piyarūpaṃ sātarūpan'ti yaṃ lokasmiṃ piyasabhāvañ'c'eva madhurasabhāvañ'ca.

examples.text: yaṃ loke piyarūpaṃ sātarūpaṃ, etth'esā taṇhā uppajjamānā uppajjati, ettha nivisamānā nivisati

ye'pi hi keci, bhikkhave, anāgatam'addhānaṃ samaṇā vā brāhmaṇā vā yaṃ loke piyarūpaṃ sātarūpaṃ taṃ aniccato dakkhissanti dukkhato dakkhissanti anattato dakkhissanti rogato dakkhissanti bhayato dakkhissanti, te taṇhaṃ pajahissanti.

62149.meaning1: accompanied by pleasure; filled with happiness
62149.commentary: (DNa) sātasahagatā'ti ṭhapetvā catutthajjhānaṃ aññattha sātasahagatā hoti sukhasampayuttā, taṃ sandhāy'etaṃ vuttaṃ.

examples.text: katamo eko dhammo bhāvetabbo? kāyagatāsati sātasahagatā. ayaṃ eko dhammo bhāvetabbo.

imaṃ samādhiṃ savitakkam'pi savicāraṃ bhāveyyāsi, avitakkam'pi vicāramattaṃ bhāveyyāsi, avitakkam'pi avicāraṃ bhāveyyāsi, sappītikam'pi bhāveyyāsi, nippītikam'pi bhāveyyāsi, sātasahagatam'pi bhāveyyāsi, upekkhāsahagatam'pi bhāveyyāsi.

62150.meaning1: attached to pleasure; clinging to comfort

examples.text: saritāni sinehitāni ca, somanassāni bhavanti jantuno, te sātasitā sukh'esino, te ve jātijar'ūpagā narā.

62151.meaning1: pleasure of happiness; happiness of pleasure; (comm) pleasure of the first three jhānas

examples.text: katamāni dve? sātasukhañ'ca upekkhāsukhañ'ca. imāni kho, bhikkhave, dve sukhāni.

62153.construction:
sātā + giri + a + ā
sātāgira + ā

examples.text: sātāgirā tisahassā, yakkhā nānattavaṇṇino, iddhimanto jutimanto, vaṇṇavanto yasassino, modamānā abhikkāmuṃ, bhikkhūnaṃ samitiṃ vanaṃ.

62154.meaning1: based on pleasure (of jhāna); founded on happiness (of meditation)

examples.text: katamāni dve? sāt'ārammaṇañ'ca sukhaṃ upekkh'ārammaṇañ'ca sukhaṃ. imāni kho, bhikkhave, dve sukhāni.

tena kho pana samayena sātissa nāma bhikkhuno kevaṭṭaputtassa evarūpaṃ pāpakaṃ diṭṭhigataṃ uppannaṃ hoti, tath'āhaṃ bhagavatā dhammaṃ desitaṃ ājānāmi yathā tadev'idaṃ viññāṇaṃ sandhāvati saṃsarati anaññan'ti.

62156.meaning1: pleasurable thing; enjoyable object; gratifying experience; (comm) pleasure of the five senses

examples.text: sātiyesu anassāvī, atimāne ca no yuto, saṇho ca paṭibhānavā, na saddho na virajjati.
sātirekāni, ānanda, pañcasatāni nātike upāsakā kālaṅ'katā, tiṇṇaṃ saṃyojanānaṃ parikkhayā sot'āpannā avinipātadhammā niyatā sambodhiparāyaṇā.
tattha paññābalī'ti pārihāriyapaññāya vipassanāpaññāya ca vasena abhiṇhaso sātisayena paññābalena samannāgato.

62159.commentary: (VINa) appaṇāmento upajjhāyo sātisāro hotī'ti sadoso hoti, āpattiṃ āpajjati, tasmā na sammā vattanto paṇāmetabbo'va. (PYt) sātisāro hotī'ti ettha pakatibhāvaṃ atikkamitvā saraṇaṃ pavattanaṃ atisāro, doso. saṃvijjati so etassā'ti sātisāro'ti dassento āha sadoso hotī'ti.

examples.text: pañcahi, bhikkhave, aṅgehi samannāgataṃ saddhivihārikaṃ appaṇāmento upajjhāyo sātisāro hoti, paṇāmento anatisāro hoti.

62160.meaning1: with sweet water; with pleasant water
62160.meaning2: with sweet water; with pleasant water

62161.meaning1: with sweet water; with pleasant water

examples.text: seyyathā'pi, āvuso, pokkharaṇī acch'odakā sāt'odakā sīt'odakā setakā supatitthā ramaṇīyā nānārukkhehi sañchannā.

62162.meaning1: in meaning; in spirit; (or) with meaning; meaningful

examples.text: so dhammaṃ deseti ādikalyāṇaṃ majjhekalyāṇaṃ pariyosānakalyāṇaṃ sātthaṃ sabyañjanaṃ

62163.synonym: atthakara, atthakaraṇa, atthāvaha, atthika, atthiya, atthūpasaṃhita, upakāra, kusala
62163.commentary: (MNa) tattha abhikkamanacitte uppanne cittavaseneva agantvā kiṃ nu me ettha gatena attho atthi n'atthī'ti atth'ānatthaṃ pariggaṇhitvā atthapariggahaṇaṃ sātthakasampajaññaṃ.

examples.text: tattha, sātthakasampajaññaṃ, sappāyasampajaññaṃ, gocarasampajaññaṃ, asammohasampajaññaṃ'ti catubbidhaṃ sampajaññaṃ.

62165.meaning1: attentiveness to what is important; clear awareness of what is beneficial
62165.commentary: (MNt) sātthakassa sampajānanaṃ sātthakasampajaññaṃ. sappāyassa attano upakār'āvahassa hitassa sampajānanaṃ sappāyasampajaññaṃ abhikkam'ādīsu bhikkhācāragocare, aññatth'āpi ca pavattesu avijahite kammaṭṭhānasaṅkhāte gocare sampajaññaṃ gocarasampajaññaṃ. abhikkam'ādīsu asammuyhanameva sampajaññaṃ asammohasampajaññaṃ.

examples.text: tattha abhikkamanacitte uppanne cittavaseneva agantvā kiṃ nu me ettha gatena attho atthi n'atthī'ti atth'ānatthaṃ pariggaṇhitvā atthapariggahaṇaṃ sātthakasampajaññaṃ.

62166.meaningLit: in meaning and in letter; in sense and in phrasing
62166.commentary: (MNa) sātthaṃ sabyañjanan'ti yassa hi yāgu-bhatta-itthi-puris'ādi-vaṇṇanā nissitā desanā hoti, na so sātthaṃ deseti. bhagavā pana tathārūpaṃ desanaṃ pahāya catusatipaṭṭhān'ādinissitaṃ desanaṃ deseti. tasmā sātthaṃ desetī'ti vuccati. yassa pana desanā ekabyañjan'ādiyuttā vā sabbaniroṭṭhabyañjanā vā sabbavissaṭṭha-sabbaniggahīta-byañjanā vā, tassa damiḷakirāsavarādimilakkhūnaṃ bhāsā viya byañjanapāripūriyā abhāvato abyañjanā nāma desanā hoti.

examples.text: ye te dhammā ādikalyāṇā majjhekalyāṇā pariyosānakalyāṇā sātthaṃ sabyañjanaṃ, kevalaparipuṇṇaṃ parisuddhaṃ brahmacariyaṃ abhivadanti

62167.commentary: (MNa) sāthaliko'ti sithilaggāhī, sāsanaṃ sithilaṃ katvā gaṇhāti, daḷhaṃ na gaṇhāti.

examples.text: ye'me, bho gotama, puggalā… sāmaññe anapekkhavanto sikkhāya na tibbagāravā bāhulikā sāthalikā okkamane pubbaṅ'gamā paviveke nikkhittadhurā… na tehi bhavaṃ gotamo saddhiṃ saṃvasati.

idh'āvuso satthu pavivittassa viharato sāvakā vivekaṃ n'ānusikkhanti, yesañ'ca dhammānaṃ satthā pahānam'āha, te ca dhamme nappajahanti, bāhulikā ca honti, sāthalikā, okkamane pubbaṅ'gamā, paviveke nikkhittadhurā

62171.commentary: (VVt) sādaran'ti bhāvanapuṃsakaniddeso. sādaraṃ vā pārupitabban'ti yojanā, sādaraṃ pārupanaṃ kattabban'ti attho.

sa + ā + √dar + a + aṃ
sādara + aṃ
62172.commentary: (VVt) sādaran'ti bhāvanapuṃsakaniddeso. sādaraṃ vā pārupitabban'ti yojanā, sādaraṃ pārupanaṃ kattabban'ti attho.

examples.text: bahuṃ bahūnaṃ cirakālañ'ca dento yathā adāsi, taṃ dassetuṃ sakkaccañ'cā'ti'ādi vuttaṃ. tattha sakkaccan'ti sādaraṃ, anapaviddhaṃ anavaññātaṃ katvā. sahatthā'ti sahatthena, na āṇāpanamattena.
aviruddhaṃ viruddhesu, attadaṇḍesu nibbutaṃ, sādānesu anādānaṃ, tam'ahaṃ brūmi brāhmaṇaṃ.

62175.meaning1: could be consented to; could be accepted; should be permitted (by)

examples.text: tañ'ce aññātako gahapati vā gahapatānī vā bahūhi cīvarehi abhihaṭṭhuṃ pavāreyya, santar'uttaraparamaṃ tena bhikkhunā tato cīvaraṃ sāditabbaṃ. tato ce uttari sādiyeyya, nissaggiyaṃ pācittiyaṃ.
natv'ev'āhaṃ, gāmaṇi, kenaci pariyāyena jātarūparajataṃ sāditabbaṃ pariyesitabban'ti vadāmī'ti.

asīti me, āvuso, vassāni pabbajitassa n'ābhijānāmi gahapaticīvaraṃ sāditā. yaṃ'p'āyasmā bākulo asītiyā vassehi n'ābhijānāti gahapaticīvaraṃ sāditā, idam'pi mayaṃ āyasmato bākulassa acchariyaṃ abbhutadhammaṃ dhārema.

62178.notes: Passive in construction but active in meaning.

examples.text: seyyath'idaṃ, nando vaccho, kiso saṃkicco, makkhali gosālo, etehi, bho gotama, acelakā mutt'ācārā hatth'āpalekhanā naehibhaddantikā natiṭṭhabhaddantikā na abhihaṭaṃ na uddissakataṃ na nimantanaṃ sādiyanti
kappati samaṇānaṃ sakyaputtiyānaṃ jātarūparajataṃ, sādiyanti samaṇā sakyaputtiyā jātarūparajataṃ, paṭiggaṇhanti samaṇā sakyaputtiyā jātarūparajatan'ti!

yo kho, nāgita, na'y'imassa nekkhammasukhassa pavivekasukhassa upasamasukhassa sambodhasukhassa nikāmalābhī assa akicchalābhī akasiralābhī… so taṃ mīḷhasukhaṃ middhasukhaṃ lābhasakkārasilokasukhaṃ sādiyeyyā'ti.
api ca kho mātugāmassa ucchādanaparimaddananhāpanasambāhanaṃ sādiyati.

dujjānaṃ kho etaṃ, mahārāja, tayā gihinā kāmabhoginā puttasambādhasayanaṃ ajjhāvasantena kāsikacandanaṃ paccanubhontena mālāgandhavilepanaṃ dhārayantena jātarūparajataṃ sādiyantena, ime vā arahanto, ime vā arahattamaggaṃ samāpannā'ti.
ekapādena aṭṭhāsiṃ, āsanaṃ parivajjayiṃ, sukkhagūthāni ca khādiṃ, uddesañ'ca na sādiyiṃ.

62186.meaning1: having consented; having agreed (to); having accepted; having permitted
62186.meaning2: having accepted, having agreed to, having permitted

examples.text: kāḷakā bhamaravaṇṇasādisā, vellit'aggā mama muddhajā ahuṃ, te jarāya sāṇavākasādisā, saccavādivacanaṃ anaññathā.
atha kho, bho, mahāgovindo brāhmaṇo yena cattārīsā bhariyā sādisiyo ten'upasaṅkami, upasaṅkamitvā cattārīsā bhariyā sādisiyo etadavoca
rasañ'ca bhotvāna asāditañ'ca sāduṃ, atho'pi bhotvāna asādum'ekadā, sāduṃ rasaṃ n'ājjhosāya bhuñje, virodham'āsādusu n'opadaṃsaye.
pahūtavitto puriso, sahirañño sabhojano, eko bhuñjati sādūni, taṃ parābhavato mukhaṃ.

62190.meaning1: delicious food; tasty food; savoury food

examples.text: kathañ'hi nāma samaṇā sakyaputtiyā sūpam'pi odanam'pi attano atthāya viññāpetvā bhuñjissanti! kassa sampannaṃ na manāpaṃ! kassa sāduṃ na ruccatī'ti!
saddh'īdha vittaṃ purisassa seṭṭhaṃ, dhammo suciṇṇo sukham'āvahati, saccaṃ have sādutaraṃ rasānaṃ, paññājīviṃ jīvitam'āhu seṭṭhan'ti.
evaṃ vutte āyasmā ānando bhagavantaṃ etadavoca, seyyathā'pi, bhante, puriso jighacchādubbalyapareto madhupiṇḍikaṃ adhigaccheyya, so yato yato sāyeyya, labheth'eva sādurasaṃ asecanakaṃ

62194.meaning1: (gram) factor which makes an action possible; element; cause

62197.meaning1: wanting something good; looking for something of quality

examples.text: kalyāṇakamyataṃ upādāyā'ti sādh'atthiko mah'aggh'atthiko. tassa vacanena āyataṃ vā vitthataṃ vā appitaṃ vā saṇhaṃ vā cetāpeti, payoge dukkaṭaṃ.
idha ākhyāte aniddiṭṭhesu sādhanesu kvaci dhātu vibhatti paccayānaṃ dīgha viparīt'ādesa lop'āgama'icc'etāni kāriyāni jinavacan'ānurūpāni kātabbāni.
jāyati, kareyya, jāniyā, siyā, kare, gacche, jaññā, vakkhetha, dakkhetha, dicchati, agacchi, agacchuṃ, ahosi, ahesuṃ icc'evam'ādīni aññāni'pi sādhanāni yojetabbāni.
